title: The or Team
rule: The letters o and r together are a combination and say /or/, like in corn. Put an arc under them. The letters a and r say /ar/, like in car.
trickText: Find the o and r together. They are a combination, so put an arc under both letters. Then listen: if it sounds like corn, use o r. If it sounds like car, use a r.
say: Today's case: the or team. When o and r are together, they are a combination and say or, like in corn. We put an arc under both letters. Listen carefully, and do not mix it up with a r, like in car.

activities.instruction: Draw an arc under the combination.
Listen to the word. Choose or, or ar.
